messages:
maya: Heads up — after rolling q4 quant profile for new-model-x to ded, our structured-output evals show func-call schema pass rate dropping from ~98% -> 72% on nightly runs :confused:
maya: attaching a couple of failing examples (short)
maya: ```
{"id":"r1","tool_call":{"name":"search","args":"q=redwood"},"tool_result":null}
```
liam: Wow that's a big jump. Do you have a link to the failing run and the exact eval harness commit?
maya: CI run: https://ci.internal/blue/7890 (label: eval/structured-toolcalls). Harness @commit ef3a4b. I can repro locally with the same seed.
liam: Can you paste the command you used to repro?
maya: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model new-model-x --quant q4 --seed 42 --limit 5000 --reporter ndjson`
arjun: Looks like `tool_result` is null in many failing traces. Our previous metric allowed null tool_result for some models; schema validator maybe tightened in the new validator bump?
arjun: Another theory — when q4 runs, the stream framing changes chunk boundaries and our ndjson reassembly in runner sometimes yields `null` for tool_result because of a parse error. I've seen similar with q8b chunking.
sasha: @maya can you run `eval-runner --dump-frames` and attach one of the raw frames where it appears null? If it's a reassembly issue we should see malformed JSON frames.
maya: attaching one raw frame here (trimmed):
```
{frame: "{\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"search\",\"args\":\"q=redwood\"}\n"}
```
liam: That raw frame shows a missing closing bracket — looks like streaming boundary cut off. Might be a bug in the runner's ndjson buffer logic under small chunk sizes introduced by q4.
ci-bot: CI results for run ef3a4b: eval/structured-toolcalls FAILED (72% schema pass). Re-run queued: https://ci.internal/blue/7891
tom: Quick note — our metric definition was recently changed in metrics.yaml to reject `tool_result: null` (reason: stricter correctness). If the model legitimately returns null sometimes, we should update metric or adjust schema. We should not silence real regressions.
arjun: Agreed. Two parallel actions: 1) test harness fix for ndjson reassembly (short-term hotfix), 2) confirm whether null tool_result is valid for this model and document expected behavior (longer fix).
sasha: I'll open a tracker for the harness fix (ENG-ML-8421) and add triage steps. Maya can you attach 5 failing examples and the local repro logs to the ticket?
maya: added examples to the ticket and pushed logs: s3://redwood-dev/evals/new-model-x/q4-fail-samples.tar.gz
liam: For the hotfix, simplest guard is to detect incomplete frames and accumulate up to a 2KB window before attempting parse; that should stop the premature nulls. I can send a PR for that today.
sasha: Please also add a unit test that simulates chunked frames with randomized cut points. We have a flaky history there.
ci-bot: Re-run finished: https://ci.internal/blue/7891 — PASS at 97% for baseline quant profile (q8), FAIL at 73% for q4 (same pattern).
tom: FYI, if we need immediate customer rollback route, we can pin new-model-x to q8 in Dedicated for affected customers while we patch. Ops runbook updated: ops/docs/rollbacks.md
arjun: Can someone do a quick bisect to confirm whether the validator bump or the quant rollout timing lines up? If it's the validator bump then it's strictly metric/schema change; if it's reassembly it's harness.
maya: I bisected — harness commit unchanged; validator bump (libjsonschema 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0) landed in the same window as the q4 rollout but I reproduced the broken frame locally when running with a simulated small socket chunk size, so both effects present.
liam: Okay plan: 1) Liam PR to add accumulation guard + unit test (hotfix to runner). 2) Sasha file ticket for metrics decision and possible temporary metric relax (if product agrees). 3) Tom coordinate Dedicated pin for any customers showing errors. 4) Maya continue collecting failing traces and run bisect against validator versions.
sasha: assigning ENG-ML-8421 to @liam for runner fix, ENG-ML-8422 to @maya for spec examples, ENG-ML-8423 to @tom for ops pin. Acceptance: new unit test covering chunked NDJSON, CI green on q4 after fix, and a clear doc note on allowed tool_result values.
maya: I'll also add a short eval that asserts that `tool_call` parsing never returns null unless the raw stream is explicitly `null` token.
liam: PR incoming in ~2 hours.
arjun: Thanks all. If anyone sees other structured-output flakiness, drop here and CC the incidents channel if it hits customers. :thumbsup:
